algorithm1_local_neighborhood_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (q : SourceNorm) (center candidate : Point) (r : \mathbb{R}), candidate \in LocalNeighborhood E q center r \iff candidate \in solutionSpace \land normDistance q candidate center \le r

algorithm1_norm_projection_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (q : SourceNorm) (project : Point \to Point), IsNormProjectionOnto E q project \iff \forall (y : Point), project y \in solutionSpace \land IsMinOn (fun x  =>  normDistance q x y) solutionSpace (project y)

algorithm1_projected_trajectory_feasible.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} {E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point} {q : SourceNorm} {project : Point \to Point} {raw trajectory : \mathbb{N} \to Point}, IsNormProjectionOnto E q project \to trajectory 0 \in solutionSpace \to (\forall (t : \mathbb{N}), Algorithm1ProjectedUpdate project (raw t) (trajectory (t + 1))) \to \forall (t : \mathbb{N}), trajectory t \in solutionSpace

algorithm1_projected_update_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Point : Type u_1} (project : Point \to Point) (raw next : Point), Algorithm1ProjectedUpdate project raw next \iff next = project raw

algorithm1_radius_sum_tendsto_atTop.tex_statement: \forall {r0 : \mathbb{R}}, 0 < r0 \to Tendsto (fun n  =>  \sum t \in range n, ilvRadius r0 (t + 1)) atTop atTop

algorithm1_stop_condition_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (q : SourceNorm) (trajectory : \mathbb{N} \to Point) (T N t : \mathbb{N}) (epsilon : \mathbb{R}), Algorithm1StopCondition E q trajectory T N t epsilon \iff t = T \lor Algorithm1WindowStable E q trajectory t N epsilon

algorithm1_window_stable_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (q : SourceNorm) (trajectory : \mathbb{N} \to Point) (t N : \mathbb{N}) (epsilon : \mathbb{R}), Algorithm1WindowStable E q trajectory t N epsilon \iff \forall (l m : \mathbb{N}), l \in Icc (t - N) t \to m \in Icc (t - N) t \to normDistance q (trajectory l) (trajectory m) \le epsilon

appendix_theorem4_expected_subgradient.tex_statement: \forall {Point : Type u_1} {Theta : Type u_2} {Grad : Type u_3} (isSampleSubgradient : Point \to Theta \to Grad \to Prop) (expected : (Theta \to Grad) \to Grad) (isExpectedSubgradient : Point \to Grad \to Prop), ExpectedSubgradientTheoremStatement isSampleSubgradient expected isExpectedSubgradient

appendix_theorem5_ssgm_convergence_bound.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Coord : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to ℝ)), FiniteCoordinateILVSSGMConvergenceTheorems E

c3_product_density_coordinate_noncollisi.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] (D : FiniteCoordinateIdealDistributionData Coord) (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), \forallᵐ (ideal : Coord \to \mathbb{R}) \,\partial idealMeasure, \forall (i : Coord), x i \ne ideal i

conditions_c123_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point), assumption_conditions_c123 E \iff solutionSpace_nonempty_bounded_closed_convex \land uniqueIdealSolutions \land idealDistribution_bounded_measurable_density

definition1_finite_coordinate_l1_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Coord : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})), UsesFiniteCoordinateNormDistance E \to (IsLpNormedUtilities E l1 \iff \forall (v : Voter) (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), utility v x = -l1 fun m  =>  x m - ideal v m)

definition1_finite_coordinate_l2_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Coord : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})), UsesFiniteCoordinateNormDistance E \to (IsLpNormedUtilities E l2 \iff \forall (v : Voter) (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), utility v x = -l2 fun m  =>  x m - ideal v m)

definition1_finite_coordinate_linf_formu.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Coord : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})), UsesFiniteCoordinateNormDistance E \to (IsLpNormedUtilities E linfty \iff \forall (v : Voter) (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), utility v x = -linf fun m  =>  x m - ideal v m)

definition1_finite_coordinate_lp_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Coord : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})), UsesFiniteCoordinateNormDistance E \to \forall (p : \mathbb{R}), IsLpNormedUtilities E (lp p) \iff \forall (v : Voter) (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), utility v x = -lp p fun m  =>  x m - ideal v m

definition1_lp_normed_utilities_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (p : SourceNorm), IsLpNormedUtilities E p \iff \forall (v : Voter) (x : Point), utility v x = -normDistance p x (ideal v)

definition2_weighted_euclidean_utilities.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} {Component : Type u_3} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (W : WeightedEuclideanStructure Voter Point Component), IsWeightedEuclideanUtilitiesWith E W \iff weightsAndIdealsDistributionCondition \land \forall (v : Voter) (x : Point), utility v x = -\sum k \in components, weight v k / weightNorm2 v * componentDistance k x v

definition3_decomposable_utilities_formu.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} {Coord : Type u_3} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (D : DecomposableStructure Voter Point Coord), IsDecomposableUtilitiesWith E D \iff coordinateUtilitiesConcave \land \forall (v : Voter) (x : Point), utility v x = \sum m \in coords, coordinateUtility m v (coordinate m x)

dlcdBudgetUtility.tex_statement: {Dim : Type*} [Fintype Dim] (isExpense : Dim \to Bool) (componentUtility : Dim \to ℝ \to ℝ) (deficitWeight : ℝ) (x : Dim \to ℝ) = (\sum m : Dim, componentUtility m (x m)) - deficitWeight * ((\sum m : Dim, if isExpense m then x m else 0) - (\sum m : Dim, if isExpense m then 0 else x m))

lemma3_coordinate_equality_bad_event_nul.tex_statement:
orall {Coord : Type u_1} [Fintype Coord] [inst : MeasurableSpace (Coord 	o \mathbb{R})] {
u \mu : Measure (Coord 	o \mathbb{R})} {C : ENNReal}, HasBoundedDensity 
u \mu C 	o  orall (x : Coord 	o \mathbb{R}), ( orall (i : Coord),

\forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] (\rho : Measure \mathbb{R}) [SigmaFinite \rho] [NoAtoms \rho] {\mu : Measure (Coord \to \mathbb{R})} {C : ENNReal}, HasBoundedDensity (pi fun x  =>  \rho) \mu C \to \forall (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), \mu (coordinateEqualityBadEvent x) = 0

lemma3_coordinate_noncollision_ae_from_p.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] (\rho : Measure \mathbb{R}) [SigmaFinite \rho] [NoAtoms \rho] {\mu : Measure (Coord \to \mathbb{R})} {C : ENNReal}, HasBoundedDensity (pi fun x  =>  \rho) \mu C \to \forall (x : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), \forallᵐ (ideal : Coord \to \mathbb{R}) \,\partial \mu, \forall (i : Coord), x i \ne ideal i

lemma3_finite_holder_dual_gradient_candi.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] {p q : \mathbb{R}}, HolderDualFinite p q \to \forall {x ideal : Coord \to \mathbb{R}}, (\forall (i : Coord), x i \ne ideal i) \to finiteCoordinateNorm (lp q) (lpCostGradientCandidate p fun i  =>  x i - ideal i) = 1

lemma3_gradient_candidate_hasFDerivAt_fo.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] {p : \mathbb{R}}, 1 < p \to \forall {x ideal : Coord \to \mathbb{R}}, (\forall (i : Coord), x i \ne ideal i) \to HasFDerivAt (fun y  =>  lp p fun i  =>  y i - ideal i) (coordinateLinearFunctional (lpCostGradientCandidate p fun i  =>  x i - ideal i)) x

lemma3_gradient_candidate_source_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] {p : \mathbb{R}}, 0 < p \to \forall (d : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), lpCostGradientCandidate p d = fun i  =>  |d i| ^ (p - 1) * (d i / |d i|) / lp p d ^ (p - 1)

modelA_response_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (q : SourceNorm) (center : Point) (r : \mathbb{R}) (voter : Voter) (response : Point), ModelAResponseAt E q center r voter response \iff response \in LocalNeighborhood E q center r \land \forall candidate \in LocalNeighborhood E q center r, utility voter candidate \le utility voter response

modelA_response_isMaxOn_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (q : SourceNorm) (center : Point) (r : \mathbb{R}) (voter : Voter) (response : Point), ModelAResponseAt E q center r voter response \iff response \in LocalNeighborhood E q center r \land IsMaxOn (utility voter) (LocalNeighborhood E q center r) response

modelA_response_lp_normed_cost_minimizer.tex_statement: \forall {Voter : Type u_1} {Point : Type u_2} (E : ILVEnvironment Voter Point) (p q : SourceNorm) (center : Point) (r : \mathbb{R}) (voter : Voter) (response : Point), IsLpNormedUtilities E p \to (ModelAResponseAt E q center r voter response \iff response \in LocalNeighborhood E q center r \land IsMinOn (fun candidate  =>  normDistance p candidate (ideal voter)) (LocalNeighborhood E q center r) response)

modelB_finite_response_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] (q : SourceNorm) (center : Coord \to \mathbb{R}) (r : \mathbb{R}) (gradient response : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), ModelBFiniteResponseAt q center r gradient response \iff response = fun i  =>  center i + r * (gradient i / finiteCoordinateNorm q gradient)

modelB_finite_response_neg_lp_cost_gradi.tex_statement: \forall {Coord : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Coord] [inst_1 : Nonempty Coord] {p q : \mathbb{R}}, HolderDualFinite p q \to \forall {center ideal : Coord \to \mathbb{R}}, (\forall (i : Coord), center i \ne ideal i) \to \forall (r : \mathbb{R}) (response : Coord \to \mathbb{R}), ModelBFiniteResponseAt (lp q) center r (fun i  =>  -lpCostGradientCandidate p (fun j  =>  center j - ideal j) i) response \iff response = fun i  =>  center i - r * lpCostGradientCandidate p (fun j  =>  center j - ideal j) i

paper_definition4_dlcd_formula.tex_statement: {Dim : Type*} [Fintype Dim] (utility : (Dim \to ℝ) \to ℝ) (isExpense : Dim \to Bool) (componentUtility : Dim \to ℝ \to ℝ) (deficitWeight : ℝ) = 0 \le deficitWeight \land (\forall m : Dim, ConcaveOn ℝ Set.univ (componentUtility m)) \land \forall x : Dim \to ℝ, utility x = dlcdBudgetUtility isExpense componentUtility deficitWeight x

proposition1_weighted_euclidean_l2.tex_statement:
\forall {Voter Coord} [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})),
Proposition1SourceSemantics E \to proposition1Statement E.
Expanded proposition1Statement E: for every component type, if ConditionsC123 E and there exists a WeightedEuclideanStructure W with IsWeightedEuclideanUtilitiesWith E W, then for every Model A or Model B response model obeyed by E, ILVConvergesToSocietalOptimal E L2 model.

proposition2_decomposable_linf_medians.tex_statement:
\forall {Voter Coord : Type} [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] [DecidableEq Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})),
Proposition2FiniteCoordinateSourceSemantics E \to proposition2FiniteCoordinateStatement E.
Expanded proposition2FiniteCoordinateStatement E: for every decomposable structure D on the ambient finite coordinates, if ConditionsC123 E, IsDecomposableUtilitiesWith E D, and D.coordinate m x = x m for every active coordinate m, then for every Model A or Model B response model obeyed by E, ILVConvergesToMedianSet E Linf model.

theorem1_lp_normed_dual_cases.tex_statement:
\forall {Voter, Coord} [Fintype\ Coord] [Nonempty\ Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment\ Voter\ (Coord \to \mathbb{R})), theorem1Statement(E).
Expanded theorem1Statement(E): for every source norms p and q and response model, if ConditionsC123(E), IsLpNormedUtilities(E,p), the model is Model A or Model B, E responds according to that model, and Theorem1NormPair(p,q) holds, then ILVConvergesToSocietalOptimal(E,q,model).
The proof consumes the approved theorem-shaped SSGM convergence boundary through assumption_ssgm_convergence_theorem, although that axiom is not a visible theorem premise.

theorem2_modelB_holder_dual_norms.tex_statement:
\forall {Voter Coord} [Fintype Coord] [Nonempty Coord] (E : ILVEnvironment Voter (Coord \to \mathbb{R})),
Theorem2PrimitiveSourceSemantics E \to theorem2Statement E.
Expanded theorem2Statement E: for every real p q, if ConditionsC123 E, IsLpNormedUtilities E (lp p), E responds according to Model B, and p,q are finite Holder duals with p>0, q>0, 1/p+1/q=1, then ILVConvergesToSocietalOptimal E (lp q) ModelB.

theorem3_statement_of_full_sampled_proje.tex_statement: For every finite voter type, finite nonempty coordinate type, measurable singleton voter space, ILV environment E over finite-coordinate real vectors, and sampled projected source-semantics record M, if E.solutionSpace = Set.univ, then the exact paper Theorem 3 statement theorem3Statement E holds.
